reviews.comment: This is an online class. His voice is somewhat monotonic and a few lectures were a bit boring. However, he explains everything very clearly and intuitively. I learned a lot from this class. The PPT and examples are great. Exams are straightforward. Very approachable and provides a lot of guidance. Highly recommend

reviews.comment: He made what appears to be a boring accounting subject interesting and relevant for students. Really tries to do what is best for students and actually cares about his students. I found the interaction with him outside class to be very helpful - he was very patient and respectful. He replied to my emails quickly. I wish he taught more classes.

reviews.comment: This is an online class even during non-pandemic times. While some of the lectures seem to be boring (this is intro accounting after all), Dr. Cohen gave many real life examples and anecdotes which helped me understand the implications of the material. Office hours were extremely helpful - very patient guy who was always willing to help Recommend!

I took a self paced class which I did not enjoy. The video lectures are read directly from the textbook. The class itself is really an introduction so there is a lot of useful terms to learn! Study well from the textbook and you can get an A!

It may be because it was all prerecorded lectures due to being an online class but the lectures were just him reading out of a textbook while scrolling through PowerPoint slides. Made it very hard to maintain focus through a whole lecture and to absorb the information since it felt more like reading than being taught. Grade is based on 3 assignment

Dr Cohen is a great guy but he can get boring during the lectures mostly due to the dense accounting material. He will try to help you out as much as he can at the end of the semester with the final project, and if you reach out to him hes happy to help. Take him if you get the chance but dont expect the easiest class!
